title: Scalar-square naturality for given normalized signed pullback families
statement: Under the same ringed-site assumptions and commuting coefficient square as [lem-pur-signed-line-scalar-pullback-square], assume the four lines, degree-one isomorphisms and scalar square, normalized signed scalar comparisons of [lem-pur-signed-line-scalar-tensor-tower], and given signed pullback families P,Q satisfying the predicates of [def-pur-signed-line-pullback-normalization-data]. Then their scalar square commutes in every integer degree. No families are constructed and no uniqueness is asserted.

source.place: Tags 03EL (tensor pullback), 0GMX (internal-Hom pullback), 0FNY (finite free dual), 04J0 (localization); blueprint/latest prop-weil-twist-preserves.proof.md, tensor powers and internal Homs.

proof.text: The unit of the module pullback adjunction is natural in module morphisms and in site objects and is semilinear on sections. For a basis section e of M on C/V, use the basis chart unit ≅ M|V, the localized pullback comparison, the pulled chart, and the canonical pulled-unit isomorphism to trivialize (FM)|U(V). The localization comparison unit equation shows that the pulled section of e maps to 1. Naturality of this trivialization proves that its restrictions are bases on every target slice object. Transport through the given isomorphism p.

For a signed basis family E, define its target family degree by degree by applying P to the adjunction-unit section of E. The preceding basis transport proves the basis condition. The zero and positive recursion clauses follow directly from the normalization of P and E. At negative degrees the normalized pulled evaluation on the positive basis is a(1)=1. Naturality of the resulting functional on the target slice proves the same evaluation identity on every restricted target object. Thus the family is a signed basis family; similarly for Q.

Choose a source cover trivializing L, with its signed bases E. Extend each restricted E across c to signed bases F of N using the scalar basis comparison. Their pulled P and Q images are signed bases of L′ and N′ by the preceding step. The degree-one assumed square, evaluated at E(1) and scalar 1, identifies c′ applied to the first target basis with the second. The normalized scalar comparisons B and B′ therefore carry all signed bases to each other. Test the desired equation on an arbitrary section x over V and scalar s. Sheaf separatedness for the pushforward of N′ lets us restrict along the source covering sieve. There x=r E(m); semilinearity of the adjunction unit and the scalar basis coefficient formula reduce both sides to b(ι(r)s) times the target basis and ι′(a(r))b(s) times the same basis. Multiplicativity of b and the coefficient-square hypothesis identify these coefficients. Sheaf separatedness gives the original equality.

theorem signedLineScalarPullbackSquare_of_normalized
    [HasFiniteLimits C] [HasFiniteLimits D] [PreservesFiniteLimits U]
    (_hcover : CoverPreserving J K U)

    [∀ V : D, (K.over V).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w}]
    {R S : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max u v w}}
    {R' S' : Sheaf K CommRingCat.{max u v w}} (ι : R ⟶ S) (ι' : R' ⟶ S')
    (a : (sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R ⟶

      (U.sheafPushforwardContinuous RingCat J K).obj

      a ≫ (U.sheafPushforwardContinuous RingCat J K).map

      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R))
    (N : ringedSiteModules.{max u v w}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj S))

      ((sheafCompose K (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R'))
    (N' : ringedSiteModules.{max u v w}
      ((sheafCompose K (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj S'))
    (_hL : ∃ (I : Type u) (V : I → C), J.CoversTop V ∧

        unit (((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj S).over (V i))))
    (_hL' : ∃ (I : Type u) (V : I → D), K.CoversTop V ∧
      ∀ i : I, Nonempty (L'.over (V i) ≅
        unit (((sheafCompose K (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R').over (V i))))
    (_hN' : ∃ (I : Type u) (V : I → D), K.CoversTop V ∧
      ∀ i : I, Nonempty (N'.over (V i) ≅
        unit (((sheafCompose K (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj S').over (V i))))
    (c : changeOfRingsOfUniverses ι L ≅ N)
    (c' : changeOfRingsOfUniverses ι' L' ≅ N')

    (q : (ringedSitePullbackFunctor b
      (module_pushforward_isRightAdjoint_of_universes b)).obj N ≅ N')
    (_hc : SignedLineScalarPullbackSquare ι ι' a b L N L' N' c c' p q)
    (B : ∀ m : ℤ, changeOfRingsOfUniverses ι (signedLinePower.{u, v, w} L m) ≅
      signedLinePower.{u, v, w} N m)
    (B' : ∀ m : ℤ, changeOfRingsOfUniverses ι' (signedLinePower.{u, v, w} L' m) ≅
      signedLinePower.{u, v, w} N' m)
    (_hB : SignedLineComparisonNormalized.{u, v, w} ι L N c B)
    (_hB' : SignedLineComparisonNormalized.{u, v, w} ι' L' N' c' B')
    (P : ∀ m : ℤ, (ringedSitePullbackFunctor a
      (module_pushforward_isRightAdjoint_of_universes a)).obj
        (signedLinePower.{u, v, w} L m) ≅ signedLinePower.{u, v, w} L' m)

    (hP : SignedLinePullbackNormalized a L L' p P)
